an5.140:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgan tveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati.
an5.140:1.3: Idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo sotā ca hoti hantā ca rakkhitā ca khantā ca gantā ca.
an5.140:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave rañño nāgo sotā hoti? 3.
an5.140:2.2: Idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo yam enaṃ hatthidammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāreti
an5.140:2.3: yadi vā katapubbaṃ yadi vā akatapubbaṃ
an5.140:2.4: taṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbaṃ cetasā samannāharitvā ohitasoto suṇāti.
an5.140:2.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo sotā hoti.
an5.140:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave rañño nāgo hantā hoti? 4.
an5.140:3.2: Idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṃgāmagato hatthim pi hanti hatthārūham pi hanti, assam pi hanti assārūham pi hanti, ratham pi hanti rathārūham pi hanti, pattikam pi hanti.
an5.140:3.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo hantā hoti.
an5.140:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave rañño nāgo rakkhitā hoti? 5.
an5.140:4.2: Idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṃgāmagato rakkhati purimaṃ kāyaṃ, rakkhati pacchimaṃ kāyaṃ, rakkhati purime pāde, rakkhati pacchime pāde, rakkhati sīsaṃ, rakkhati kaṇṇe, rakkhati dante, rakkhati soṇḍaṃ, rakkhati vāladhiṃ, rakkhati hatthārūhaṃ.
an5.140:4.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo rakkhitā hoti.
an5.140:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave rañño nāgo khantā hoti? 6.
an5.140:5.2: Idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṃgāmagato khamo hoti sattippahārānaṃ asippahārānaṃ usuppahārānaṃ pharasuppahārānaṃ bheripaṇavasaṅkhatiṇavaninnādasaddānaṃ.
an5.140:5.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo khantā hoti.
an5.140:6.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave rañño nāgo gantā hoti? 7.
an5.140:6.2: Idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo yam enaṃ hatthidammasārathi disaṃ peseti
an5.140:6.3: yadi vā gatapubbaṃ yadi vā agatapubbaṃ
an5.140:6.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo gantā hoti.
an5.140:7.1: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgan tveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati.
an5.140:8.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an5.140:8.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sotā ca hoti hantā ca rakkhitā ca khantā ca gantā ca.
an5.140:9.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu sotā hoti? 9.
an5.140:9.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbaṃ cetasā samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti.
an5.140:9.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sotā hoti.
an5.140:10.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu hantā hoti? 10.
an5.140:10.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti vyantikaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti, uppannaṃ vyāpādavitakkaṃ . . . uppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ . . . uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti vyantikaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti.
an5.140:10.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu hantā hoti.
an5.140:11.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu rakkhitā hoti? 11.
an5.140:11.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī,
an5.140:11.3: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati;
an5.140:11.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī,
an5.140:11.9: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
an5.140:11.10: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu rakkhitā hoti.
an5.140:12.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu khantā hoti? 12.
an5.140:12.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu khamo hoti sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ, uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsakajātiko hoti.
an5.140:12.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu khantā hoti.
an5.140:13.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu gantā hoti? 13.
an5.140:13.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yā sā disā agatapubbā iminā dīghena addhunā, yad idaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ, taṃ khippaṃ yeva gantā hoti.
an5.140:13.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu gantā hoti.
an5.140:14.1: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā ti.
